## Two pathways from one El Niño

<!-- Two layouts of one diagram: the wide one from 576 px up, the narrow one
     below (Bootstrap classes d-none d-sm-block / d-sm-none). Read from
     results/ at render time; Quarto copies the outputs into _site/. -->

::: {.d-none .d-sm-block}
```{python}
#| echo: false
#| fig-alt: "Flow diagram. El Niño, warm water in the central-eastern tropical Pacific, makes the Pacific jet stream extend east and shift south. North pathway (PNW, BC, AB): a milder, often drier winter, then less snow and earlier melt, then an earlier or longer fire season. South pathway (SoCal): a wetter winter, then more grass growth, then more fine fuel once the grass cures and larger grass fires. Footnote: these are expected pathways tested in this study; AK and YT are also analysed, as northern regions, with no pathway drawn because their hypotheses are not yet set; NorCal is also analysed, as a contrast region, with no pathway drawn because its expected response is not yet set."
from IPython.display import SVG
SVG(filename="../results/figures/mechanism.svg")
```
:::
